claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SB-216641 is a high-affinity 5-HT1B/1D receptor antagonist that is unlikely to kill cells at 2.5 uM; any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect off-target cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress or general lipophilicity-driven toxicity rather than serotonin receptor antagonism.
